sources.title_original: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
sources.summary: If your Copilot usage metrics have shown agent activity or agent lines of code falling while Copilot usage kept growing, we’ve found the cause, and a fix is rolling out… The post Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 如果您的 Copilot 使用量指標顯示代理程式活動或代理程式程式碼行數在 Copilot 使用量持續成長的同時卻在下降，我們已經找到了原因，並且正在推出修復程式……本文譯自 The GitHub Blog 的 The post Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics

sources.title_original: Why Telecom Operators Are Building Their AI Strategy on Open Models
sources.summary: Telecom operators are increasingly building their AI strategies on open models — and the reasons go beyond mere cost. Open models give telcos the ability to trust, control and customize AI across their most critical workloads — from autonomous networks to customer care. NVIDIA’s latest State of AI in Telecommunications report reflects this shift, with […]
sources.summary_zh: 電信業者越來越常以開放模型來建構其 AI 策略，而原因不僅僅是成本。開放模型讓電信商能夠在從自主網路到客戶服務等最關鍵的工作負載中，信任、控制並客製化 AI。輝達的 最新的《電信業 AI 現狀》報告反映了這項轉變，其中包含 […]
